metas.name: The Curse
metas.description: A newlywed couple struggle to make their vision for eco-living a reality in a small New Mexico town.

metas.name: Scavengers Reign
metas.description: The crew of a damaged deep space freighter are stranded on a beautiful but dangerous planet.

metas.name: Disclaimer
metas.description: A mysterious delivery threatens to expose a celebrated journalist's past.

metas.name: Beef
metas.description: A minor conflict spirals into a consuming feud between two individuals, exposing pride, resentment, and hidden pain.

metas.name: Swarm
metas.description: A young woman's obsession with a pop star takes a dark turn.

metas.name: Ripley
metas.description: A grifter named Ripley living in New York during the 1960s is hired by a wealthy man to bring his vagabond son home from Italy.

metas.name: Adolescence
metas.description: When a 13-year-old is accused of the murder of a classmate, his family, therapist and the detective in charge are all left asking what really happened.

metas.name: Irma Vep
metas.description: Mira is an American movie star disillusioned by her career and recent breakup, who comes to France to star as Irma Vep in a remake of the French silent film classic, "Les Vampires."

metas.name: Somebody Somewhere
metas.description: Sam is a true Kansan on the surface, but, beneath it all, struggles to fit the hometown mold. Grappling with loss and acceptance, she discovers herself and a community of outsiders who don't fit in but don't give up.

metas.name: Pantheon
metas.description: A young woman starts to get messages from an unknown number that claims to be her deceased father. Trying to uncover the truth, she stumbles upon a larger conspiracy involving the singularity.

metas.name: Dead Ringers
metas.description: The Mantle twins, identical from head to toe, are on a mission to change the way women give birth.

metas.name: The Baby
metas.description: 38-year-old Natasha is furious that her closest friends are all having babies. When she suddenly finds herself with a baby of her own, her life dramatically implodes and twists itself into a bizarre horror show.

metas.name: How To with John Wilson
metas.description: An anxious New Yorker attempts to give everyday advice while dealing with his own personal issues.

metas.name: We Are Who We Are
metas.description: Two American kids who live on a U.S. military base in Italy explore friendship, first love, identity, and all the messy exhilaration and anguish of being a teenager.

metas.name: The Leftovers
metas.description: Three years after the disappearance of 2% of the global human population, a group of people in a small New York community try to continue their lives while coping with the tragedy of the unexplained nature of the event.

metas.name: Station Eleven
metas.description: A post apocalyptic saga spanning multiple timelines, telling the stories of survivors of a devastating flu as they attempt to rebuild and reimagine the world anew while holding on to the best of what's been lost.

metas.name: Devs
metas.description: A computer engineer investigates the secretive development division in her company, which she believes is behind the disappearance of her boyfriend.

metas.name: The Rehearsal
metas.description: Nathan Fielder gives people a chance to rehearse for their own lives in a world where nothing ever works out as expected.

metas.name: Twin Peaks: The Return
metas.description: Picks up 25 years after the inhabitants of a quaint northwestern town are stunned when their homecoming queen is murdered.

metas.name: I May Destroy You
metas.description: The question of sexual consent in contemporary life and how, in the new landscape of dating and relationships, we make the distinction between liberation and exploitation.

metas.name: Midnight Mass
metas.description: An isolated island community experiences miraculous events - and frightening omens - after the arrival of a charismatic, mysterious young priest.

metas.name: The Returned (Les Revenants)
metas.description: In a small French mountain town where everyone knows each other, the dead begin to inexplicably return as if their death never happened. Forcing the townsfolk to confront their difficult past as they seek to understand this phenom...

metas.name: Inside No. 9
metas.description: Genre-mixing anthology series, inviting viewers into some very different and enigmatic No. 9s.

metas.name: Los Espookys
metas.description: A group of friends turns their love for horror into a peculiar business, providing horror to those who need it in a dreamy Latin American country where the strange and eerie are just part of daily life.

metas.name: Tales from the Loop
metas.description: The townspeople who live above "The Loop," a machine built to unlock and explore the mysteries of the universe, experience things previously consigned to the realm of science fiction.

metas.name: Fantasmas
metas.description: It follows the tale of when Julio Torres lost a golden oyster.

metas.name: Interview with the Vampire
metas.description: A vampire tells his epic story of love, blood, and the perils of immortality to a journalist.
